prompt: Create a polished realistic illustrated miniature for our scientific chart. Soft studio key from screen UPPER LEFT/NW, smoothly darker lower-right, enough fill to read whole silhouette. Restrained natural palette and fine readable detail. Artist interpretation of WASP-12 b: very dark charcoal-plum hot gas giant with barely visible smooth bands, slightly egg-shaped tidal stretching along horizontal axis, gentle warm upper-left illumination and subtle thin atmospheric edge. Not a black silhouette. White sphere reference for lighting.
note: Interpretive illustration. Mission photos constrain observed shapes; unresolved and unlit detail is inferred. Exoplanets and Psyche are artist interpretations, not resolved photographs.
